# Data Directory

## Raw Data
Place the raw dataset here:
- `delivery_data.csv` — Delhivery trip segments (144,867 rows × 24 columns)

## Processed (auto-generated by pipeline)
- `data/processed/cleaned_data.csv` — After deduplication + feature engineering (14,778 rows)
- `data/processed/final_data.csv` — Cleaned data + graph centrality features

These files are generated by running:
```bash
python3 src/data_preprocessing.py
python3 src/graph_builder.py
```
